standard_references.evidence: The SDMX 2.0 materials are the requested target standard for this package. The supplied SDMX 2.0-oriented principles define a Dataflow as a logical flow or dataset using a particular DSD / Key Family, and the report-to-structure modelling uses that role to identify logical disseminated datasets rather than visual tables.

The fetched SDMX Global Registry interface excerpt lists Dataflows among SDMX structural artefact categories, confirming that dataflows are a recognised SDMX registry artefact category. The excerpt does not provide details of a specific dataflow for this report.

The accepted related DSD / Key Family artifact was modelled against SDMX 2.0 Key Family practice. The present Dataflow artifact references those accepted Key Families as the structural definitions used by each logical dataset.

limitations: The report names the maintaining organisation as Synthetic Labour Observatory but does not provide a formal SDMX agency identifier; Synthetic_Labour_Observatory is therefore a local normalized agency identifier derived from the report label.
The report does not provide formal Dataflow IDs, versions or operational subset constraints; IDs and version 1.0 are proposed local artefact metadata.
The Dataflows reference accepted related Key Families, but no externally registered SDMX Dataflow or Key Family for this synthetic report was supplied.
The report contains only one publication instance with 2025 observations; the Dataflow names and IDs intentionally omit the year because no evidence indicates separate year-specific flows.
Exact standard codelist versions and some code mappings remain limitations of the accepted DSD artifact and are not resolved at Dataflow level.

dataflows.name: Quarterly unemployment rate by region and sex
dataflows.description: Logical dataset for quarterly unemployment-rate observations from synthetic survey estimates for persons aged 15-64, with unemployment rate measured as unemployed persons as a percentage of the labour force and broken down by region, sex and quarter.
dataflows.coverage: Synthetic unemployment-rate estimates for Northland, Centralia and South Coast; sex labels Women, Men and Total; quarters 2025-Q1 and 2025-Q2 shown in the report; unit Percent; status Final or Provisional. Total sex coverage includes respondents outside the displayed women/men categories and must not be inferred by summing displayed rows.

dataflows.name: Monthly job vacancies by industry
dataflows.description: Logical dataset for monthly job-vacancy counts compiled independently from a synthetic employer survey, with a job vacancy defined as an unfilled position available for immediate recruitment and observations broken down by local industry aggregate and month.
dataflows.coverage: Synthetic job-vacancy counts for Manufacturing, Construction and Information services; months 2025-01, 2025-02 and 2025-03 shown in the report; unit Open positions; adjustment Seasonally adjusted. Industry labels are local aggregates and are not confirmed ISIC categories.
